title: 第二千六百六十八章 一步到位的岛礁群据第二千六百六十七章 扫货不存在的
content_zh:
，，！
一步到位的岛礁群据点（形等诸多形体存在，只是相较于鱼形舰船的比例较少。
罗格·乌特金当初为了改造大明宝船舰队，也花费了不少功夫。
先将桅杆拆除，然后在船身套上一层仿生虾壳，将其伪装成虾头，接着在船尾整出小一号，甚至小好几号的虾身和虾尾，借此伪装成虾形船舰。
由于桅杆拆除的缘故，伪装成虾形船舰的大明宝船舰队，主要是靠船身底下充当虾脚的船桨作为动力。
要不是大明宝船舰队的坐船可以招募大明水师等傀儡，罗格●乌特金鼓捣出来的伪虾形大明宝船舰队，就是纯粹的样子货，光靠船舰上的玩家根本驱动不了。
不过话说回来，将大明宝船舰队伪装成虾形船舰的过程，虽然把罗格●乌特金一行人搞得挺狼狈的，但他们也因此掌握了蛮荒古国最核心的几样造船工艺。
只要给罗格●乌特金一行人足够的海王类生物素材，他们现在是真的可以建造出蛮荒古国的仿生船舰。
因为蛮荒古国压根儿就没有正儿八经的造船工艺，靠的是海王类生物的素材和赋灵的仪轨。
讲难听一点儿的，只要海王类生物的素材管够，且拥有适合的海王类生物灵魂可以用来赋灵，然后掌握完整的祭祀仪轨，几乎任何人都可以建造得出来，只是层次品质不好说而已。
有鉴于此，罗格●乌特金在用赛特兰●碉堡建立起岛礁群据点以后，刻意开辟出一条地底航道，并用一整个分区用来造船，船坞、港口和码头等设施一应俱全。
未来若收集到足够多的海王类生物素材，罗格●乌特金甚至能在岛礁群据点的地底船坞，建造属于自己的鸿鲲巨船。
不过这是题外话，在此暂且带过。
且说，罗格●乌特金一行人所搭乘的虾形船舰，虽是用大明宝船舰队伪装改造而成，但也确实附加不少属于蛮荒古国的手段。
虽然说，这种程度的伪装改造，并没有让大明宝船舰队真的变成蛮荒古国的虾形船舰，但也使其拥有虾形船舰的部分特性，如若不然也没有办法瞒过蛮荒古国的原住民npc。
（请）一步到位的岛礁群据点（第22页）因此，这些伪装成虾形船舰的大明宝船舰队是拥有潜水功能的，尽管下潜深度有限，水下潜航速度也不怎么样，但确实能够潜水。
所以，罗格●乌特金在完成岛礁群据点的建设以后，就让伪装成虾形船舰的大明宝船舰队潜伏在岛礁群周围的海床上。
由于《帝望》本身就有地底世界存在，在艾洛西亚等人重生以前，就有玩家提出人工建造地底世界的方案。
只可惜，未等玩家们验证这个方案的可行性，《帝望》就在猝不及防间关服了。
不过，在艾洛西亚等人重生以后，威廉●道奇补上了这个遗憾，验证了这个方案的可行性。

只不过，人工建造地底世界虽然可行，其限制却是不小。
人工（挖掘）建造的地底世界，顶部距离地表至少五十米，且距离海平面高度至少三十米，然后地底世界的平均高度不得低于五十米，面积不得小于一万平方米。
只要没有满足上述任一条件，就不会得到帝望规则的认可，无法成为所谓的地底世界。
看到这里或许有人会问：为什么要提到这个？因为地底世界是可以使用建村令建造领地的。
是的，没错！
罗格●乌特金利用赛特兰●碉堡拓展的地底建筑群，以其建筑结构撑起了人造地底世界的穹顶。
位于岛屿群中心位置，地底下最大的一座人造地底世界，罗格●乌特金用建村令建立起一座领地。
虽然受限于人口不足，这座玩家领地在短时间内只升到乡级就升不上去了，但其领地建筑却齐全到堪称豪华。
只要把人口补齐，再使用城市之心，然后建造传送阵，直升县城级领地不是问题。
某个腹黑的乐子人见状，不禁暗自点了点头：还算有点儿脑袋。
随着岛礁群据点的建立，岛礁群的地形结构得到修复，地脉能量场域也就自然而然地恢复过来。
这对岛礁群据点来说，并不是一件好事。
因为地脉能量场域会驱散周围的海上迷雾，使岛礁群的存在变得格外显眼，凡是有点儿眼力的人，都能看出岛礁群的问题。
可在岛礁群的地底下，人为建造地底世界并设置领地，情况就完全不一样了。
此举虽然会使地脉能量场域的恢复速度进一步加快，但也会使地脉能量场域潜得更深，尽管其存在会使岛礁群周围的海上迷雾变得稀薄，却不至于彻底驱散，使岛礁群直接暴露在众人面前。
与此同时，在帝望规则的作用下，隶属于地底世界的地脉能量场域，还有凝聚矿脉的特性。
随着人造地底世界的进一步挖掘和开发，发现矿脉并稳定出产各类矿石资源，只是时间早晚的问题。
当岛礁群据点乃至人造地底世界的玩家领地被彻底开发出来，甚至能作为罗格●乌特金建立海外势力的根基。
从这方面来说，罗格●乌特金直接走在其他所有玩家的前面，包含艾洛西亚等其他重生者在内。
直接一步到位了属于是。
content_en:

There are many shapes such as islands and reefs strongholds (shaped) that are in place in one step, but the proportion is smaller compared to the fish-shaped ships.
Roger Utkin also spent a lot of effort to transform the Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleet.
The mast is first removed, and then a layer of bionic shrimp shell is put on the hull to disguise it as a shrimp head. Then a shrimp body and tail that are one size smaller, or even several sizes smaller, are made on the stern to disguise it as a shrimp-shaped ship.
Due to the dismantling of the masts, the Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleet disguised as shrimp-shaped ships mainly relied on the paddles under the hulls that acted as shrimp legs for power.
If it weren't for the Ming Dynasty's navy and other puppets that can be recruited on board the ships of the Ming Dynasty's treasure fleet, the pseudo-shrimp-shaped Ming Dynasty's treasure ship fleet that Roger Utkin tinkered with would be purely cosmetic and could not be driven by the players on the ships alone.
But having said that, the process of disguising the Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleet into shrimp-shaped ships made Rogge Utkin and his team quite embarrassed, but they also mastered some of the core shipbuilding techniques of the ancient wild country.
As long as Rogge Utkin and his team are given enough Neptune-like biological materials, they can now really build a bionic ship of the ancient wild country.
Because the ancient wild country had no serious shipbuilding technology at all, it relied on materials from Neptune-like creatures and spiritual rituals.
To put it bluntly, almost anyone can build it as long as they have enough materials for Neptune-like creatures, have suitable souls of Neptune-like creatures that can be used to animate spirits, and then master the complete sacrificial rituals. It’s just that the quality is hard to say.
In view of this, after Rog Utkin established a stronghold on the islands and reefs with Setran Bunker, he deliberately opened up an underground channel and used an entire area for shipbuilding, with docks, ports, docks and other facilities.
In the future, if enough Neptune-like biological materials are collected, Roger Utkin can even build his own Hongkun giant ship in the underground dock of the island group base.
But this is a digression, so I’ll mention it here for now.
Moreover, although the shrimp-shaped ship that Rogge Utkin and his party boarded was disguised as a fleet of Ming treasure ships, it did have a lot of features that belonged to the ancient barbaric country.
Although this level of camouflage transformation did not turn the Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleet into the shrimp-shaped ships of the ancient wild country, it also gave it some of the characteristics of shrimp-shaped ships. Otherwise, there would be no way to hide it from the aboriginal NPCs of the ancient wild country.
(Please) One-step island and reef stronghold (page 22) Therefore, these Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleets disguised as shrimp-shaped ships have diving functions. Although the diving depth is limited and the underwater diving speed is not very good, they can indeed dive.
Therefore, after Rog Utkin completed the construction of the island group's stronghold, he let the Ming Dynasty treasure ship fleet disguised as shrimp-shaped ships lurk on the seabed around the island group.
Since "Emperor's Hope" itself has an underground world, before Aelosia and others were reborn, some players proposed a plan to artificially build an underground world.
Unfortunately, before players could verify the feasibility of this plan, "Emperor's Hope" was shut down unexpectedly.
However, after Aelosia and others were reborn, William Dodge made up for this regret and verified the feasibility of this plan.
However, although it is feasible to artificially build an underground world, its limitations are not small.
The top of an artificial (excavated) underground world must be at least fifty meters above the surface and at least thirty meters above sea level. The average height of the underground world must not be less than fifty meters, and its area must not be less than ten thousand square meters.
As long as any of the above conditions are not met, it will not be recognized by the Emperor's Rules and cannot become the so-called underground world.
When you see this, some people may ask: Why do you need to mention this? Because in the underground world, you can use village building orders to build territories.
Yes, that’s right!
Roger●Utjin used the underground building complex expanded by Setlan ●Bunker to support the dome of the artificial underground world with its architectural structure.
Located in the center of the island group, the largest man-made underground world underground, Rogge Utkin established a territory with a village establishment order.
Although due to insufficient population, this player's territory only reached the township level in a short period of time and then failed to move up, the territory's buildings are so complete that they can be called luxurious.
As long as you fill up the population, use the heart of the city, and then build a teleportation array, it is not a problem to directly upgrade to county-level territory.
Seeing this, a certain shady Lezi man couldn't help but nodded secretly: He still has some brains.
With the establishment of strongholds on the islands and reefs, the topographic structure of the islands and reefs has been repaired, and the leyline energy field has naturally recovered.
This is not a good thing for the island and reef base.
Because the leyline energy field will dispel the surrounding sea fog, making the existence of the islands and reefs particularly conspicuous. Anyone with a little vision can see the problems of the islands and reefs.
But under the islands and reefs, where people build underground worlds and set up territories, the situation is completely different.
Although this move will further accelerate the recovery speed of the leyline energy field, it will also make the leyline energy field dive deeper. Although its existence will thin the sea fog around the island groups, it will not completely dissipate, leaving the island groups directly exposed to the public.
At the same time, under the influence of the Emperor's Hope Rules, the leyline energy field belonging to the underground world also has the characteristics of condensed mineral veins.
With the further excavation and development of the man-made underground world, it is only a matter of time before mineral veins are discovered and various ore resources are stably produced.
When the island group strongholds and even the player territories in the artificial underground world are fully developed, they can even serve as the foundation for Rogge Utkin to establish overseas power.
In this regard, Rogge Utkin is directly ahead of all other players, including Aelosia and other reborns.
It’s a direct step to get it right.
